ledger: Man (sole character) | short neat brown hair, clean-shaven, slim build, green-and-white vertical striped button-up shirt over white crew-neck tee, NO eyeglasses at first sight | same man at end seen in left-facing profile, now WEARING eyeglasses, outer clothing obscured by transition | static, centered, chest-up, facing camera/slightly screen-right while speaking from 0:00-0:07; crossfade ~0:07-0:08; after transition he is turned away, facing screen-left near a door at frame left; no other characters present, so no relative-position constraints

findings.description: From 0:00-0:07 the man's face is clearly bare - no eyeglasses worn, held, or visible on his person. At the crossfade (~0:07-0:08) he reappears in profile wearing eyeglasses. No on-screen action shows him obtaining or putting on glasses, and the change occurs entirely within the dissolve; the position/facing change is explainable as elapsed time, but the glasses appear from no established source, reading as either an unexplained accessory change or an intentional time-skip/aging dissolve.
